_design_notes: Test config for NPC/vendor bidirectional transactions. Goals: (1) Currency transfers TO NPCs (deposits, bribes, fees), (2) Item transfers FROM NPCs (purchases, loans), (3) SD-7 as broker/escrow agent, (4) NPC-facilitated player-to-player transfers, (5) Verify structured output captures all transaction types.

scenario.location: The Crossroads Exchange - Neutral Trading Post
scenario.situation: The Crossroads Exchange is a cramped but bustling trading post wedged between faction territories. Three vendors operate here with distinct transaction styles. Kael Voss runs a traditional stall where he accepts deposits, holds items in escrow, and brokers deals between customers who don't trust each other. SD-7, an automated supply drone, offers microloans, payment plans, and acts as a neutral intermediary for contested transactions—it can hold currency from one party until another delivers goods. The Nexus Terminal requires soulcredit but accepts advance deposits to reserve items. Your party has specific transaction goals: test giving currency TO vendors (deposits, fees, bribes), receiving items on credit, using SD-7 as an escrow agent for player-to-player deals, and having Kael broker a three-way trade. Every transaction should be logged with proper structured output.
environmental_factors: Active trading hours - vendors fully staffed
Kael offers escrow services for 1 Drip fee
